go clean -modcache # want:go-clean-cache
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\go-build" # want:env-path-delete
$cache = go env GOCACHE
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $cache # want:env-path-delete
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $HOME ".cache") # want:env-path-delete
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .\build
Remove-Item -Force "$env:TEMP\x.txt"
